Headquartered in New York City with US offices and facilities located in New Jersey, Ohio, Texas and Florida, Shiseido Americas employs over 2,000 individuals in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Shiseido Americas is a hub of talent and innovation. Be inspired by the array of skills, knowledge, and integrity of your colleagues, and join our driving force as Shiseido continues its pursuit of beauty innovations for a better world.

At Shiseido Americas, we focus on our people. We strive to foster a collaborative workplace culture where creative thinking, inclusivity and unique diverse perspectives are celebrated in order to drive success for both our employees and the company as a whole. By prioritizing our team and promoting an open-minded environment, we push the boundaries of what's possible and bring new ideas to life.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Planner position, under Key Account Planning Team, is responsible for developing a strategic annual retail and net sales plan by channel for their accounts. This role requires a data-driven, analytical mindset to interpret business trends, identify growth opportunities, and optimize inventory productivity to reduce liabilities. By proactively identifying strategies to drive revenue and mitigate unproductive stock, the Key Account Planner plays a pivotal role in achieving financial targets.

Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams – including Marketing, Sales Operations, Customer Service, and respective Retail Account Buying Teams – the Key Account Planner ensures seamless execution of account strategies. Through precision planning and strategic inventory management, this role directly contributes to maximizing sales performance and delivering both gross and net sales objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

FORECASTING

  • You will support and partner with Director and ED, Key Account Planning in building bottoms up budgets and on-going forecasting and achievement of retail and net sales plans
  • You will forecast returns and DIFs, managing discontinuations to reduce RTV liabilities, retrieving necessary approvals, and partnering with finance on timing and estimates
  • You will analyze retailer OTB monthly, ensuring no changes or potential issues after each month’s lock
  • In partnership with Director, Key Accounts, you will develop annual, quarterly, monthly and mid-month retail and shipment projections with keen communication to ED, Key Accounts on changes
  • You will build and revise retail/gross sku forecasts in accordance with monthly projections, collaborating with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment
  • You will ensure orders are received from retail partners in a timely manner and troubleshoot errors
  • You will reconcile chargebacks received from retail partners to ensure deductions are with budget expectations
  • You will collaborate with internal partners on creating sales goals by door, week, quarter, and channel during budgeting and re-trending moments
  • You will build retail sales plans for new launches, tracking achievement and sell-thru of established sales objectives, including analysis for Limited Edition and Holiday product lines

REPORTING

  • You will be using COGNOS and retailer reporting, pull weekly sales data and analyze sell-thru results to inform weekly commentary
  • You will provide weekly sales recap to key internal stakeholders and leadership, summarizing achievements, promotions, marketing activities
  • You will deliver weekly by door sales recaps to Sales Training Executives.

MISCELLANEOUS

  • You will support monthly consensus process by providing updated retailer sku projections, insights, and relevant reporting
  • You will track ROI and sales lift on retailer secondary exposures and marketing activities to inform co-op spend
  • You will plan and allocate monthly sampling and GWPs to strategically support retail sales
  • You will consistently communicate with field and retail partners regarding inventory concerns and business opportunities
  • You will maintain agendas for weekly recurring touch bases with internal stakeholders and retail partners
  • You will execute ad hoc reporting and analysis requests

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in related field
  • You have 5+ years of retail planning experience (Buying Office or extensive Head Quarter experience)
  • You are highly skilled in inventory planning, forecasting gross/net shipments, and bottoms up build required
  • You must have advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint (pivot tables, vlookups, sumif, etc.)
  • You can fully read, analyze and understand retailer OTB’s
  • You have demonstrated ability to build gross to net and retail sales plans from the bottom up
  • You have strong knowledge and experience with the prestige cosmetic industry & retail planning systems
  • You can work under pressure and fluctuating deadlines with a high number of tasks
  • You should possess strong analytical, organizational and communication skills
  • You have strong attention to detail, high sense of responsibility, dependable and self-starter
  • You must be flexible and adaptive to changing priorities

Data Analytics Manager

The Data Analytics Manager will lead a remote, cross-functional team of data analysts, systems analysts, and data scientists delivering analytics products, data systems, dashboards, and decision-support tools for federal programs, including initiatives serving refugee, immigrant, and social service populations.

This role combines technical project management, analytics leadership, stakeholder engagement, and systems oversight. The manager will guide the development of modern data platforms and products, support automation and advanced visualization, promote predictive and proactive decision-making, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage delivery of data and analytics projects, including dashboards, data products, reports, documentation, platform enhancements, and system upgrades.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, resource plans, deliverable schedules, and risk and issue logs.
  • Advise clients and stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, resource needs, and delivery timelines.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison for data, analytics, and reporting initiatives.
  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions, present findings, and review deliverables with senior stakeholders.
  • Translate business, operational, and policy questions into effective analytical approaches and data products.
  • Oversee the design and deployment of Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards that provide actionable insights and support self-service analytics.
  • Lead scalable data preparation, integration, and automation efforts using tools such as SQL, R, Python, Tableau Prep, ETL/ELT tools, and Databricks.
  • Guide the use of statistical methods, modeling techniques, geospatial analysis, and advanced visualization to answer complex program questions.
  • Validate models, metrics, and analytical approaches to ensure accuracy and relevance.
  • Foster innovation by piloting new tools, modernizing workflows, and promoting continuous improvement.
  • Lead and mentor a geographically distributed team of senior analysts and data scientists.
  • Provide technical direction, performance guidance, and support for staff development.
  • Promote strong practices in data intake, validation, analysis, visualization, documentation, and dissemination.
  • Ensure rigorous quality assurance for dashboards, datasets, reports, and technical documentation.
  • Oversee metadata, data dictionaries, and reference documentation to support data governance, transparency, and reuse.
  • Coordinate recurring leadership reporting, cross-program analyses, and urgent or ad hoc data requests.
  • Stay current on emerging analytics, visualization, and data platform tools and recommend adoption where appropriate.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or related field, such as Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Economics, or Public Policy with a quantitative focus.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience interpreting and analyzing quantitative and qualitative data in complex environments.
  • 3+ years managing data, analytics, business intelligence, product, or technical projects; Agile or iterative delivery experience preferred.
  • 3+ years of supervisory, team lead, project management, program management, or product management experience.

Job Duties

The Virginia Employment Commission (VEC) is seeking a detail-oriented Appeals Examiner who will conduct administrative hearings and issue well-supported decisions for unemployment insurance appeals, state set‑off debt collection matters, labor disputes, disaster relief cases, and other programs authorized by federal and state law. This role reviews case materials, researches applicable laws and regulations, leads fair and impartial hearings, administers oaths, determines when witnesses or subpoenas are needed, rules on evidence, and ensures an accurate record of testimony. It also involves issuing timely written decisions, managing caseloads, completing required administrative reports, communicating respectfully and professionally with customers and stakeholders, and supporting agency efforts to reduce improper payments.

Join the VEC and be part of a mission-driven agency dedicated to supporting workers, strengthening communities, and promoting economic stability across the Commonwealth. We administer Virginia’s Unemployment Insurance (UI) benefits program with a commitment to providing customer-centered, accessible, inclusive, and impactful services to support our shared mission: lifting up Virginia, one unemployed worker at a time. The VEC is also an integral part of a historic milestone as Virginia becomes the first state in the South to offer Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML). Our agency will be responsible for standing up and administering this new program, which will expand the vital support we provide for employees when they need it most.

We offer paid leave; a minimum of 13 paid state holidays per year; medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options; retirement plans (including 401a Cash Match and 457 Deferred Compensation Plan for classified positions); and are a federally recognized Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) employer.

If you’re motivated by public service, continuous improvement, and meaningful work that supports opportunity for all, the VEC is a place where your contributions matter!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience applying the rules and regulations governing eligibility and qualification for benefits.
    • Proficiency with administrative law procedures for conducting hearings, due process rights, and legal research methodology and terminology.
    • Strong analytical, decision making, and a strong command of oral and written communication.
    • Experience with managing a substantial caseload, conducting fair hearings and controlling the process.
    • Experience ascertaining and evaluating facts, as well as applying related laws and regulations.
    • Skilled in analyzing information, organizing facts and testimony into written decisions, proofreading, identifying problems, and resolving issues.
    • Demonstrated ability to successfully work independently, as well as working effectively with the public, members of the business community, co-workers, and management.

Additional Considerations

  • Knowledge of statutory and regulatory provisions governing unemployment compensation (e.g. Virginia Unemployment Compensation Act).
    • Experience interpreting relevant laws, rules and regulations and conducting UI administrative hearings.
    • Experience conducting administrative hearings and preparing case decisions; and/or making legal decisions.

Special Instructions

You will be provided a confirmation of receipt when your application and/or résumé is submitted successfully. Please refer to “Your Application” in your account to check the status of your application for this position.

  • This is a remote position and qualifies for a 10% Northern Virginia (NOVA) Pay Differential if the selected candidate’s primary residence is located in a DHRM designated NOVA locality. The NOVA Pay Area, as defined in DHRM Policy 3.05, currently includes Arlington, Fairfax, Loudoun, and Prince William counties, and the Cities of Alexandria, Fairfax, Falls Church, Manassas, and Manassas Park.

    Submission of an online application is required for this position. The VEC does not accept applications, résumés, cover letters, etc., in any other format. When applying for jobs, please ensure your online application and/or résumé are complete with duties and skills associated with your work experience.

    The Virginia Employment Commission is committed to upholding our values in our employment opportunities across the Commonwealth to people from all backgrounds, including all races, ethnicities, genders, and abilities. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer/Program, and a Virginia Values Veterans (V3) certified employer. AmeriCorps, Peace Corps, and other national service alumni are encouraged to apply.

    The selected candidate must successfully pass a comprehensive background check including an FBI fingerprint background investigation and an Unemployment Insurance (UI) fraud background check.

    Please carefully review the details of this recruitment including the location of the position and the posted salary before applying. The VEC does not provide relocation assistance, and no salary will be offered outside of the posted salary range / flat rate.

    The VEC does not provide sponsorship; therefore, applicants must be a citizen or national of the U.S., a Lawful Permanent Resident, or an alien authorized to work in the US.

    Auxiliary Aids and Services are available upon request to individuals with disabilities. Applicants needing accommodations should contact the Human Resource office for additional information.

    A valid Virginia Driver's License is required to operate a state vehicle or if operating a personal vehicle while conducting business on behalf of the agency.

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

The University of Miami/UHealth Department of Uhealth Connect has an exciting opportunity for a Full Time Supervisor, Contact Center to work Remotely. The individual in this position is part of the UHealth Connect Contact center and will be responsible for supporting functions that assist in creating and driving a culture of empathy, service excellence and delivery of patient centered care that impacts the patient experience across the UHealth System. Our Department thrives on teamwork and collaboration, and we know our employees achieve the greatest results when they are working together for a common goal. The incumbent is responsible for supervising a team of contact center agents who are responsible for patient access and registration for the University of Miami Health System. Success in this position requires the ability to manage, motivate and encourage agents through positive communication and feedback. This role also requires being available to affect the entirety of the team's operations by effectively building call center culture according to our core values promoting and fostering an environment where staff feels a sense of “purpose, worthwhile work, and making a difference.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Supervises over the daily work flows of staff to ensure performance goals for customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, and key performance metrics are consistently met.

  • Monitors and analyzes quantitative service and productivity metrics (i.e. average speed to answer, abandon rate, service level, appointments scheduled, etc.)

  • Partners with Quality Assurance team to monitor and analyze team’s quality and patient satisfaction metrics (i.e. call monitoring for adherence, compliance of registration documentation, etc.).

  • Coordinates with Flight Control team to maximize staff productivity and availability within the contact center.

  • Collaborates with other internal teams to provide cross coverage activities in order to ensure that UHealth Connect meets customer expectations.

  • Assists the Patient Access Manager with planning, organizing and scheduling for the daily expected call service level, volumes of visits pending verification and authorization within 14 days of scheduled appointment, including same day appointments and add-on in office procedures for the UMMG Practice.

  • Ensures that appointments scheduled are accurate and payors meet time frame for authorization guidelines for financial clearance of appointment prior to patient’s arrival.

  • Communicates policy changes and all business operation updates to staff on a timely basis. Conducts department wide meetings to maintain two- way communication, problems solving, and relaying information

  • Supervises, orients, trains, evaluates and monitors on the job performance for staff responsible for verification of benefits, obtaining authorization and registration of insurance information in UChart.

  • Administers training programs for new hires and existing staff including refining and scheduling appropriate training sessions.

  • Uses best practice techniques to motivate and to encourage agents through positive communication and feedback. Develops contests, awards and themes that increase agents' loyalty, commitment, and focus.

  • Conducts formal performance reviews, including annual goal-setting/performance development plan, mid-year performance review, and final year- end performance review.

  • Establishes and continuously assesses the effectiveness of the internal controls within the unit and compliance with University policies and procedures. Ensures employees are trained on controls within the function and on University policy and procedures.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.

CORE QUALIFICATIONS:

High School Diploma or equivalent is required, Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field preferred

Minimum 4 years of relevant experience required

Knowledge, Skills and Attitudes:

  • Experience as change agent, motivator and influencer in a setting employing at least 50 people

  • Comfortable designing and delivering small and/or large group training

  • The ability to communicate effectively with all types of people at all levels is critical.

  • Ability to manage and coordinate the activities of other employees and ensure a high level of performance.

  • Excellent customer service skills.

  • Ability to maintain effective interpersonal relationships.

  • Commitment to the University’s core values.

  • Ability to direct, manage, implement, and evaluate department operations.

  • Ability to establish department goals and objectives that support the strategic plan.

  • Ability to effectively plan, delegate and/or supervise the work of others.

  • Ability to lead, motivate, develop and train others.

  • Proficiency in computer software (i.e. Microsoft Office).

Any relevant education, certifications and/or work experience may be considered.

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.

The University of Miami is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are protected from discrimination based on certain categories protected by Federal law.

Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at

Job Summary

As DigiCert continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Business Partner to lead hiring for positions across Technical, G&A, and Sales teams throughout the United States and Canada.

Candidates based in EST timezone preferred.

As a strategic member of the global Talent Acquisition organization, you will partner closely with business leaders to develop recruiting strategies that attract exceptional talent in highly competitive markets. You will influence hiring decisions through market intelligence, talent mapping, and data-driven recruiting practices while delivering an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience.

This is a highly visible role requiring someone who thrives in complex searches, understands today's technology landscape, and enjoys solving difficult hiring challenges through innovative sourcing strategies and consultative partnership.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full lifecycle recruitment process for positions across technical, G&A, and Sales.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand business priorities, organizational design, and hiring requirements.
  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies that identify passive technical talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, open-source communities, professional associations, and networking.
  • Build long-term talent pipelines for critical skill sets and hard-to-fill positions.
  • Conduct recruiter screens that effectively evaluate backgrounds, career progression, and overall fit before presenting candidates.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation trends, competitive hiring insights, and talent availability.
  • Influence hiring decisions through structured interviewing, calibration sessions, and data-driven recommendations.
  • Partner with hiring leaders to develop interview plans, competency-based assessments, and consistent evaluation processes.
  • Leverage recruiting metrics including time-to-fill, quality of hire, funnel conversion, offer acceptance, and sourcing effectiveness to continuously improve results.
  • Drive an exceptional candidate experience through proactive communication, transparency, and timely follow-up.
  • Continuously evaluate recruiting processes, tools, and technologies to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Partner with HR, Compensation, and Total Rewards throughout the offer process to ensure competitive and equitable hiring decisions.
  • Participate in strategic Talent Acquisition initiatives, employer branding, process improvement, and global recruiting projects.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of full lifecycle recruiting experience, including recruiting within a high-growth technology company or executive search environment.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development organizations and technical hiring practices.
  • Exceptional sourcing skills with proven experience identifying passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean techniques, professional communities, and other innovative and creative sourcing methods.
  • Experience managing multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to influence hiring leaders through data, market insights, and recruiting expertise.
  • Experience interpreting recruiting analytics and using data to improve hiring outcomes.
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems, with a preference for Greenhouse.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving global environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting within cybersecurity, identity and access management (IAM), PKI, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, AI, or enterprise software organizations.
  • Experience partnering with globally distributed organizations.
  • Experience recruiting executive-level leadership positions.

Why Join DigiCert

You'll help build the teams shaping the future of digital trust. From AI security and post-quantum cryptography to PKI, identity, and enterprise security, you'll recruit world-class technical talent that enables organizations around the globe to operate securely.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate / Clinical Research Associate II - Oncology -
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is seeking a Senior Clinical Research Associate or Clinical Research Associate II who is experienced in Oncology On-Site Monitoring on the West Coast, US!

Job Purpose:

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and sponsor standards. The Sr. CRA is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders. The Sr. CRA is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner (SCP), and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close-out of sites in a clinical trial.

Key Accountabilities:

Oversight of Monitoring Responsibilities and Study Conduct

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan (SMP) and applicable prevailing laws, GCP, and sponsor standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality

  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site activation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met

  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery

  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites

  • Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks

  • Attend investigator meeting when required (virtual or F2F). Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and

  • recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level

  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the SMP, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies

  • Monitor site level adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs) and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution

  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File (TMF) documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics

  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues

  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines

  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities

  • Support database release as needed

  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where appropriate

Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk

  • Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team

  • Interact with investigator site heath care professionals in a manner which enhances sponsor’s credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate sponsor’s clinical development goals

  • Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators

  • Drive Quality Event (QE) remediation, when applicable

  • Serve as a point of contact for audit conduct, and drive Audit Observation corrective action/preventive action (CAPA) development and checks, when applicable

Collaboration

  • Reports to Director of Clinical Site Operations (DCSO) or Director of Site Management and Monitoring (DSMM)

  • Partners with SCP and Country Study Operations Manager (SOM)

  • When required Partners with other Study Team members (e.g. Clinician, Recruitment Specialist, Clinical Data Scientist)

  • May act as a Mentor for Clinical Research Associates

Skills:

  • Monitoring Experience: Minimum 3 years relevant experience in clinical research site monitoring (preferably 2 years in Oncology) in a CRO or pharma organization

  • Preferred therapeutic experience in Oncology

  • Global clinical trial experience preferred

  • Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local country regulations

  • Must be fluent in English and in the native language(s) of the country they will work in

  • Travel within area is required

  • Valid driver’s license and passport required

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research and development processes and ability to gain command of process details

  • Demonstrated knowledge of global and local regulatory requirements

  • Demonstrated understanding of key operational elements of clinical research (e.g., monitoring, data acquisition and cleaning, reporting, etc.)

jobs.description:

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week

At Miaplaza, we build homeschool platforms that kids aged 4–18 actually want to use — Miacademy, MiaPrep, and our Online High School are serving over 150.000 students today. Our product foundations are strong. What we want next is a step change in how our products feel: more expressive illustration, more purposeful motion, more moments of craft that turn a lesson into something a kid remembers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer whose craft anchor is illustration and motion. Our design team is small and senior, five designers when you join, and each brings a distinct strength: brand, design systems, research, and now yours

The role

You'd own product design for the student learning experience end-to-end: from problem framing through delivery, in a Product Trio with a PM and EM who have strong opinions and expect yours. This is product work with real trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable for how it lands, not just how it looks.

Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that the other designers and the design system build from.

A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults.

You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product, and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership, cross-product influence, or both.

Requirements

You must have all of these to be considered:

  • A portfolio of shipped digital product work — not only concepts or standalone pieces

  • At least 2 years working inside a product team, collaborating with PMs and engineers

  • Strong illustration or motion skills, with at least 1 year focused on either as a primary craft

  • Proficiency in Figma

  • Some experience directing or guiding visual work produced by others — freelancers, junior designers, or AI tools

You’ll stand out if you also have:

  • Deep motion skills in product contexts: interactions, transitions, onboarding, character animation

  • Experience using AI image or motion tools as production accelerators

  • Confidence running your own usability research, not just receiving findings

  • Multi-brand or education-focused design experience

  • Accessibility practice, especially for neurodivergent audiences

This probably isn’t right for you if:

  • Your work hasn't yet lived inside a live product with real constraints

  • You prefer well-scoped tasks over shaping ambiguous problems

  • You see AI tools as either a threat to craft or a shortcut around it

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.excerpt: Join a small San Francisco startup that builds creative tools on the cutting edge of AI.
jobs.description:
Join a small San Francisco startup that builds creative tools on the cutting edge of AI. The team is remote and global.

The Role:

You are the founder’s right hand.

Where an operations manager runs the systems that already exist, you take the first step on the ones that don’t.

I want to hand you an outcome and then stop thinking about it.

  • “Figure out whether we should launch this.”

  • “Our onboarding is broken. Fix it.”

  • “Find the right vendor, negotiate it, get implementation moving.”

  • “We need a system for this. Come back with one.”

You work out what the actual problem is, research it, make the calls you can make, flag the ones I have to make, build the plan, and get the first chunk of it done before you bring it back to me.

What I am hoping to hear back sounds like: “Here’s the plan. I posted the role, screened 40 applicants, and these are the five worth interviewing.”

There is more work in front of us than there are people to own it. Your scope is wherever my priorities are. The path from here is Chief of Staff to Head of Operations.

What You’ll Own

  • Projects that do not belong to anyone yet, from framing through delivery.

  • Hiring: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and keeping the pipeline honest.

  • Contractors and artists, including scope, delivery dates, invoices, and follow-through.

  • The operating cadence: what is tracked, what is overdue, what stopped moving without anyone noticing.

  • Systems and SOPs for work that currently lives in my head.

  • Investor outreach support: build the list, help send the emails, get the calls on the calendar.

  • Whatever is on fire this month that nobody else can pick up.

Some of this is unglamorous. Calendar, inbox triage, and travel come with being the founder’s right hand. It is a small slice of the job, not the point of it, but if that part is beneath you then this is not your role.

This is probably not for you if:

  • You need tasks specified before you can start.

  • You are looking for a strategy or advisory role.

  • You would rather coordinate work than do it.

  • You wait for approval on reversible decisions.

  • You need your responsibilities to stay inside a defined box.

  • You think AI output is finished work.

On AI:

We are a slop-free startup.

AI makes output cheap, it has not made reviewing that output any cheaper. Handing us unfiltered, unreviewed, verbose AI output moves your work onto someone else’s desk. That will get you fired.

Use AI constantly, to take on more than one person could. Read everything before it leaves your hands.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of work experience, at least 2 of them owning outcomes rather than tasks.

  • Strong written English (C1+) and comfortable spoken English on a live call. You can write to an investor, a customer, and a vendor without sending the same email three times.

  • You can turn a messy topic into a short document: situation, options, recommendation, next actions.

  • You work comfortably in spreadsheets and can sanity-check costs and tradeoffs.

  • You decide without full information, and you say so when you got it wrong.

  • Discretion, because you will see everything, including what is not going well.

  • Available 9am to 5pm US Pacific, Monday to Friday. I can flex the start to 8am if that suits your day better.

  • Reliable internet with a backup plan, quality camera and headset, quiet workspace.

  • Modern laptop with 24GB+ RAM.

Backgrounds that tend to work:

  • Former founder, or agency owner and operator.

  • Early employee at a startup where everyone did everything.

  • Someone who has already been a founder’s right hand.

  • Managed complicated client projects end to end.

  • Built an operations function from nothing.

Your title matters much less to me than what you actually owned. If you have made payroll, chased an unpaid invoice, or sat across from an angry client, say so.

What success looks like:

First 90 days. You have mapped what is in flight and what has stalled. I have stopped chasing status. You have taken at least two initiatives off me end to end.

Ongoing. You bring me decisions with a recommendation attached rather than problems. Fewer things need me personally each month.

About Babou

Babou gives brand creative teams more production capability. They set the creative direction, we produce everything downstream of it: social cuts, motion graphics, VFX, in-store, and out-of-home. Brands use us to run more campaigns and more channel-specific creative without growing their production org or raising agency spend.

We are small and early. You would work directly with the founder, and you are applying to us directly rather than through a staffing agency.

Benefits

Paid in USD, monthly. Fully remote. PTO: 12 days accrued at 1 day per month, increasing to 15 at year 1. Direct access to the founder, with no agency layer in between. GSuite, Notion, Slack, Attio, Monday.com, Loom, GitHub, and whatever AI tooling makes you fastest.

jobs.description:
About Us:

Machine Solutions is the premier provider of advanced equipment and services for the medical device, biopharmaceutical, and blood- and plasma-collection industries. We support our customers’ needs and growth by delivering quality and value through a wide breadth of products. Machine Solutions provides proprietary mechanical solutions to a variety of complex process, testing and device design challenges. Our equipment has become the industry standard for stent crimping, balloon catheter pleating and folding, catheter braiding and medical device manufacturing applications. As a pioneer in radio frequency technology, the company has continued to develop advancing technology for thermal forming, molding and welding plastic for medical manufacturing, biopharmaceutical, and blood- and plasma-processing applications. Our experienced team of engineers has been instrumental in automating manual processes that enable our customers to increase production volumes and profit margins, and we believe in providing a superior customer experience by designating resources to a dedicated aftermarket team that is always ready to provide technical service and process support. Machine Solutions is privately owned by BW Forsyth Partners, a Barry-Wehmiller company.BW Forsyth Partners is the investment arm of multibillion-dollar global manufacturing and engineering consulting firm Barry-Wehmiller. Established in 2009, BW Forsyth Partners blends Barry-Wehmiller’s unparalleled legacy of value creation and people-centric culture development with keen investing experience to help companies realize their true potential. With a focus limited to areas known well, BW Forsyth Partners seeks to partner with leadership teams to acquire small- to middle-market companies in the capital and component equipment, and professional services sectors. In each of our operating companies, BW Forsyth Partners deploys operational improvements and strategy development without compromising the autonomy, strategic vision and entrepreneurial spirit of their leadership teams.

Job Description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

Director of Sales Operations

Commercial Infrastructure, Inside Sales Leadership, and Operational Excellence

About Machine Solutions, Inc.

Machine Solutions is the premier provider of advanced equipment and services for the medical device industry. Our unified brands — MSI, PlasticWeld Systems, Steeger USA, Intec Automation, BWTec, and Vante — deliver the full breadth of technologies behind minimally invasive device manufacturing, from braiding and coiling to lamination, thermal bonding, and balloon forming. We've become an essential automation partner to the world's leading medical device and life sciences manufacturers, and we back that with a dedicated aftermarket team delivering technical service and process support that customers can rely on.

We're also in the midst of a defining growth chapter. Over the past two years, our backlog has grown more than 60%, fueled by strong organic demand and a disciplined strategy of strategic acquisitions that continue to expand our capabilities and reach. This is a company scaling fast — and scaling smart.

That growth has created a rare opportunity: the newly created role of Director of Sales Operations. This is not a seat that already has an established playbook — it's a blank slate for a seasoned commercial leader who wants to build the operating backbone of a high-growth, life-sciences-focused business from the ground up. You'll design the systems, governance, and standard work that turn commercial strategy into reliable execution, working directly with the Chief Commercial Officer to shape how Machine Solutions plans, forecasts, and sells for years to come.

If you're an experienced inside sales operations leader who's energized — not intimidated — by ambiguity, and who thrives on turning a growth story into a governed, scalable commercial engine, this is your opportunity to leave a lasting mark on a company at the center of medical device innovation.


Reports to

Chief Commercial Officer

Location

Remote

Function

Sales Operations and Inside Sales

Compensation

Very competitive and commensurate with experience


Position

Summary

The Director of Sales Operations is a senior commercial leader responsible for the systems, data, analytical discipline, planning processes, operating cadences, and administrative governance required to run the Machine Solutions Commercial Operating System. The role also leads the Inside Sales organization, including the distinct customer and channel models for After Market Parts and Sealing and Welding.

Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, this leader will convert commercial strategy into reliable execution by creating one governed source of truth, strengthening Salesforce adoption, translating the fiscal-year operating plan into territories and quotas, improving forecasting and reporting, administering bookings and compensation processes, and building repeatable Inside Sales standard work.

This is not a reporting-only role. The Director will be the operating backbone of the Commercial KATA—making the current condition visible, establishing standard work, coaching adoption, and using PDCA to improve the system.

Primary Responsibilities

Sales Operations Leadership and Governance

  • Lead the Sales Operations and Inside Sales teams, establish priorities, clarify decision rights, allocate capacity, coach performance, and build a culture of humility, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Own the integrity of the commercial infrastructure, data, processes, reporting, controls, and documentation while preserving field and functional accountability for the work.
  • Translate commercial strategy and approved process changes into practical systems, workflows, reporting, training, and operating cadences.
  • Establish clear service expectations so Sales Operations remains focused on recurring, high-value work rather than becoming an undefined administrative resource.

Salesforce CRM Administration and Commercial Data

  • Administer and govern Salesforce as the commercial system of record for accounts, contacts, opportunities, pipeline, sales-process phases, quotes, forecasts, sources, next actions, and commercial history.
  • Align Salesforce workflows, required fields, phase-entry expectations, exit criteria, dashboards, and reports with the six-phase Machine Solutions Sales Process.
  • Improve CRM hygiene, data completeness, source attribution, account ownership, user adoption, training, and commercial decision support.
  • Govern customer master data, account hierarchies, seller and territory structures, product-line definitions, calculation logic, and the commercial data dictionary.
  • Connect Salesforce with quoting, order-management, Finance, compensation, and external market-data sources to create one reliable commercial information environment.

Commercial Planning, Territories, and Target Accounts

  • Translate the approved fiscal-year bookings plan into regional, territory, seller, and product-line expectations.
  • Lead territory design, quota analysis, commercial-capacity modeling, scenario analysis, plan deployment, and version control.
  • Develop and maintain territory-level customer and prospect lists using the licensed Dun & Bradstreet database and other approved sources.
  • Support customer segmentation, account tiering, whitespace analysis, ABM account selection, outbound prospecting, NPI launches, and GTS engagement.
  • Maintain alignment among territories, Salesforce ownership, quotas, reporting hierarchies, compensation structures, and the approved commercial organization.

Reporting, Forecasting, Bookings, and Compensation

  • Produce the monthly commercial reporting package, including bookings, qualified pipeline, coverage, source attribution, phase distribution, aging, quoting, conversion, forecast accuracy, NPI performance, and Commercial KATA KPIs.
  • Govern the monthly forecasting process, maintain common forecast definitions, consolidate opportunity-level commitments, preserve forecast history, and support company S&OP planning.
  • Lead quarterly bookings reconciliation with Finance, including seller, territory, customer, product-line, house-account, split-credit, cancellation, reversal, and timing exceptions.
  • Administer and analyze approved commercial compensation plans, including quotas, bookings credit, attainment, accelerators, contests, exceptions, reconciliation, and confidential supporting detail.
  • Maintain controlled definitions, authoritative data sources, calculation rules, reporting periods, and historical comparability for all recurring commercial measures.

Commercial KATA KPI and NPI Governance

  • Own KPI definitions, reporting logic, recurring analysis, target-condition tracking, historical performance, and visibility to abnormal conditions.
  • Support root-cause analysis and PDCA without substituting correlation or reporting for evidence-based leadership judgment.
  • Administer the Commercial Launch Plan & Tracker and report NPI pipeline, quotation activity, 150-day checkpoints, fiscal-year bookings, source, territory, product line, customer, and sales-process progression.
  • Preserve launch assumptions, decisions, exceptions, and learning so future product launches become more predictable and effective.

Inside Sales Leadership

The Director will lead two distinct Inside Sales applications and build the target-state standard work, role clarity, workflows, cadences, KPIs, training, and adoption required for each.

After Market Parts Inside Sales

  • Build proactive installed-base coverage, upselling, cross-selling, replenishment, quoting, quote follow-up, customer-contact cadence, and recurring-revenue discipline.
  • Establish protected prospecting blocks that use installed-machine age, historical machine placement, service history, and machine-type replacement patterns to identify likely parts needs and proactively engage customers.
  • Govern price execution, approved price lists, discount authority, pricing exceptions, and price-realization visibility.
  • Create disciplined qualification, Salesforce documentation, source attribution, and handoff of Manufacturing Equipment leads to the appropriate FLAM, including an acceptance-and-feedback loop.
  • Create reliable handoffs to the After Market Service team for technical support, field service, repair, or other service intervention, with clear ownership and customer commitments.

Sealing and Welding Inside Sales

  • Lead distributor segmentation, onboarding, coverage expectations, operating cadence, opportunity visibility, forecasting, enablement, and performance management.
  • Define lead and opportunity ownership among distributors, Inside Sales, FLAMs, GTSs, and other commercial resources.
  • Govern distributor and customer pricing, discount authority, exception approvals, and price-realization reporting.
  • Manage the commercial workflow for distributor and applicable customer agreements, including intake, review, approval routing, renewal timing, deviations, retention, and obligation visibility.
  • Serve as the commercial liaison to Marketing for sales enablement, campaigns, product messaging, training, competitive intelligence, launch support, lead follow-up, and field adoption.

Pricing and Contracting Excellence

  • Partner with Commercial, Finance, Product Line Leadership, Operations, and Legal resources to build scalable pricing governance, discount authority, quote consistency, margin visibility, pricing-action deployment, exception management, and price-realization reporting.
  • Develop consistent contracting standard work for intake, templates, commercial terms, review authority, escalation, deviations, cycle time, status visibility, executed-agreement retention, and governance.

Process Documentation, Controls, Training, and Adoption

  • Maintain controlled procedures, reporting instructions, calendars, data definitions, job aids, training, and version history for commercial systems and processes.
  • Lead onboarding and continuing education for Salesforce, forecasting, reporting, territory planning, compensation administration, and applicable commercial standard work.
  • Protect sensitive customer, pricing, forecast, bookings, performance, and compensation information through role-based access, controlled distribution, documented approvals, and appropriate separation of duties.
  • Measure adoption, identify recurring user issues, retire obsolete reports and processes, and standardize before automating.

Measures of Success

  • Salesforce accurately reflects the current state of customers, opportunities, pipeline, forecasts, and next actions.
  • Commercial leadership operates from consistent definitions, trusted reporting, and one governed source of truth.
  • Territories, quotas, target accounts, compensation structures, and reporting remain aligned with the operating plan.
  • Forecasts are evidence-based, historically measurable, and connected to S&OP.
  • Bookings and compensation outcomes are accurately reconciled, transparent, and trusted.
  • Commercial KATA KPI and NPI performance gaps are visible early enough to support coaching and corrective action.
  • Inside Sales creates measurable pipeline, bookings, price realization, customer coverage, distributor performance, lead generation, and reliable cross-functional handoffs.
  • Administrative complexity is reduced for sellers while commercial accountability and predictability increase.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of progressive sales operations leadership experience, including accountability for a Sales Operations function or major Sales Operations disciplines.
  • Demonstrated Inside Sales management experience, including direct leadership of customer-facing sellers and development of repeatable selling, coaching, and performance-management processes.
  • Strong Salesforce administration and governance experience, including CRM design, data quality, reporting, dashboards, workflow adoption, and user enablement.
  • Demonstrated experience with territory and quota planning, pipeline and forecast management, bookings reporting, compensation analysis, KPI governance, and executive reporting.
  • Advanced analytical capability with the ability to translate complex commercial data into clear operating insight and practical action.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Product Management or Product Line Leadership, Service, and Legal resources.
  • Strong business judgment, financial acumen, written communication, process design, project leadership, and change-management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, analytics, operations, marketing, or a related field—or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Leadership experience in industrial manufacturing, capital equipment, engineered products, medical-device manufacturing, or another complex B2B commercial environment.
  • Experience with licensed market databases such as Dun & Bradstreet and with target-account development, segmentation, or ABM support.
  • Experience building pricing governance, contract-management workflows, commercial data architecture, or NPI launch reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Toyota Kata, PDCA, or comparable continuous-improvement disciplines.
  • Experience leading distributed or remote teams across multiple facilities, product lines, or geographies.

Leadership Profile

  • A systems thinker who can connect strategy, process, data, people, and technology.
  • A hands-on builder who is equally comfortable establishing governance and improving daily work.
  • A humble, curious leader who asks good questions, makes problems visible, and develops people through coaching.
  • A disciplined operator who protects data integrity, confidentiality, and process credibility.
  • A collaborative partner who can influence across functions without assuming accountability that belongs to others.
  • A pragmatic change leader who standardizes thoughtfully, tests through PDCA, and improves based on evidence.


At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. jobs.description:
Spotter Labs is hiring Accounting Automation Engineers to help automate manual processes across accounting, finance, and related business systems.

This role is for someone who can understand how work is being done today, identify repetitive manual steps, connect data across systems, build automation, and create cleaner workflows that are accurate, repeatable, and scalable.

The initial focus will be Accounting and Finance, but strong performers may also support automation projects in other departments as the company continues to grow.

What You Will Do

  • Review manual accounting and finance workflows and identify opportunities for automation.

  • Build repeatable processes across multiple systems, exports, reports, and data sources.

  • Improve reconciliations, journal-entry preparation, close tracking, reporting, and exception management.

  • Help connect operational data to accounting and finance processes.

  • Create templates, scripts, dashboards, workflows, and documentation that reduce manual work.

  • Work with accounting, finance, operations, and technology teams to understand process gaps and build practical solutions.

  • Design controls so automation improves accuracy rather than simply speeding up bad processes.

  • Create exception-based workflows so teams can focus on issues instead of routine data entry.

  • Document processes clearly so they can be maintained and improved over time.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for practical automation builders who can work across business systems and messy real-world data.

The ideal candidate has:

  • Experience automating manual processes using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python, Power Query, VBA, Google Apps Script, Zapier, Make, Power Automate, APIs, or similar platforms.

  • Strong ability to work with data exports, reports, spreadsheets, and system-generated files.

  • Understanding of accounting or finance processes, including reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, AP, payroll, reporting, or financial analysis.

  • Ability to map a current process, identify failure points, and build a cleaner workflow.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work with non-technical users and translate business problems into automated solutions.

  • Good documentation habits.

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where systems and processes are still being built.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with accounting, ERP, banking, payroll, expense management, inventory, reporting, or operational systems.

  • Experience building dashboards, exception reports, reconciliation tools, or workflow automations.

  • Experience with multi-system data matching and process improvement.

  • Experience supporting accounting, finance, operations, logistics, transportation, or other data-heavy business environments.

  • Accounting, finance, data analytics, systems, or engineering background preferred.

The Type of Person Who Will Succeed

This role is best for someone who likes solving practical business problems.

You should be able to look at a manual process and ask:

  • Why is this being done manually?

  • What data is needed?

  • Where does the data come from?

  • What can be automated safely?

  • What should remain subject to review?

  • How do we prove the output is accurate?

  • How do we make the process repeatable?

We do not need someone who only writes code in isolation. We need someone who can understand the business process, work with the people doing the work, and build useful automation that holds up in the real world.

Hiring Process

Candidates may be asked to complete a practical work sample involving process mapping, data cleanup, reconciliation logic, automation design, reporting, or workflow improvement.

We are looking for candidates who can understand a problem, organize the data, build a practical solution, document their work, and explain how the process could be improved or automated.

Why This Role Matters

As Spotter Labs grows, the company needs scalable processes instead of more manual work. This role will help build the systems, workflows, and automation needed to support faster reporting, better controls, cleaner data, and more efficient operations.

About ASICS Apps

ASICS Apps lives by ASICS’ founding philosophy, "Anima Sana In Corpore Sano” or “A Sound Mind in a Sound Body.” We believe in the positive benefits of movement and aspire for people all over the world to live healthful and happy lives in both body and mind.

The ASICS Apps provide digital services and goods focused on helping runners and running events every step of the way. To strengthen our commitment to runners, we are expanding our investment in endurance-related digital services, such as endurance event technology (Race Roster), leading mobile running app (the ASICS Runkeeper app), and other exciting platforms that will help us better serve the endurance industry. Combined, these projects and products makeup ASICS Apps.

Our mission―in the past, today, and into the future―is to contribute to a healthful and sustainable society and to bring joy to the people of the world through movement. Movement is an important element in living longer healthy lives, in feeling more fulfilled, and in crossing national and cultural boundaries to bring the world together. If you are looking to join a fun and innovative company focused on the booming digital health and fitness industry, this is the place for you!

Position Overview:

As a Delivery Owner on one or more teams, you are accountable for predictable delivery across several ongoing initiatives. You will own delivery sequencing, dependency and flow management, and honest communication of committed versus likely-to-ship outcomes. You work hand-in-hand with Product Managers, as they define customer needs and priorities, while you drive the execution. You will operate in a multi-project environment, balancing competing timelines, dependencies, and capacity.

Success in this role means teams make capacity-honest commitments, surface delivery risk early, and ship with clear visibility, while Product Managers remain accountable for “what and why”.

This position requires flexibility as we respond to new business and customer requirements, while being able to quickly adapt to new strategies and priorities as they evolve.

This position is open to internal and external candidates.

Product Line:
This role will be working on the Race Roster product.

Work Location:

The successful candidate for this role can be either a remote employee (working 100% remotely from a designated location within Canada), a hybrid employee (flexibility to work in the office or from home at a location within 75 km from the London, ON office), or an in-office employee at our London, ON office.

Responsibilities:

Delivery predictability & flow (core responsibility)

  • Protect committed-vs-likely clarity. Align sprint and release commitments with team capacity, active work-in-progress (WIP), and known risks.
  • Manage flow and WIP. Update stakeholders and provide clear visibility into core deliverables versus stretch goals well before target release dates. Reduce last-minute scope churn and surprise WIP that undermines predictability.
  • Facilitate for delivery clarity. Guide team planning, stand-ups, and reviews to streamline delivery and clarify priorities. By fostering open communication and lean processes, you’ll ensure the team maintains strong shared ownership of sprint commitments without mid-cycle confusion.
  • Make delivery-track decisions. Balance delivery sequencing and cross-team dependencies to eliminate execution friction, working in close partnership with Product Managers and Engineering as they define feature requirements and strategic priorities.
  • Align stakeholders on “done.” Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders to confirm delivery readiness and agree what “done enough to ship” means for each increment before the team commits. Partner with the Product Managers to ensure requirements are clear before committing to a sprint.

Multi-project coordination & dependencies

  • Coordinate across concurrent projects. Own delivery sequencing and coordination across multiple concurrent projects or workstreams. Make timeline, dependency, and capacity trade-offs visible so competing priorities are explicit rather than discovered late in the sprint.
  • Produce capacity-honest plans. Prepare planning inputs that reflect real capacity, known dependencies, and delivery risk. “Ready to commit” means the team can stand behind the plan without discovering major delivery blockers after the sprint starts.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies for the projects you support. Take part in refinement support for delivery readiness, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives.
  • Balance near-term commitments with delivery direction. Balance sprint and release commitments with follow-on and enabling work within each project’s delivery plan, keeping upcoming delivery constraints visible.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs. Track progress against delivery goals across initiatives and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Surface cross-project dependencies across teams. Identify dependencies early and coordinate with Product Managers, Engineering leads, or stakeholders when work, releases, or shared constraints overlap.

AI adoption & modern delivery practice

  • Use AI routinely in delivery work. Use AI tools as a normal part of delivery ownership (for example: summarizing status, synthesizing risks, analyzing dependencies, preparing planning notes, drafting stakeholder updates).
  • Validate AI outputs with judgment. Check AI-assisted delivery work for accuracy, protect sensitive data, and ensure stakeholder-facing status meets quality standards.
  • Share practical AI learnings. Stay current on practical AI capabilities relevant to the industry.

Collaboration & decision-making

  • Work closely with Engineering, QA, and Product Managers. Clarify delivery questions and resolve blockers quickly, before and during build, so delivery gaps are not discovered late.
  • Cross-Team Dependency Escalation: Identify and escalate external dependencies, timeline risks, or scope impacts that fall outside the team's direct domain to Leadership, ensuring cross-functional alignment and timely resolution.
  • Champion Delivery Culture & Best Practices: Foster a team environment grounded in transparency, continuous improvement, and delivery predictability.
  • Meaningfully participate in diversity and inclusion initiatives across the ASICS Apps teams.

Education & Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Delivery Owner, Scrum Master, Technical Program Manager, Project Manager in Agile delivery, or similar role in an Agile software delivery environment.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple ongoing projects or workstreams simultaneously without losing delivery focus or commitment clarity.
  • Demonstrated experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery plans for a cloud-based product team.
  • Active, practical use of AI tools in delivery work (e.g., for status synthesis, risk analysis, planning notes, documentation, or dependency tracking).
  • Strong facilitation skills: you can guide conversations, build alignment, and keep teams focused on predictable delivery across competing priorities.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail; comfortable managing dynamic plans in a fast-paced, multi-project setting.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain what we’re committing to ship and what risks threaten that commitment.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience with backlog and delivery tools (e.g., Jira or equivalent).

Bonus Education & Experience:

  • Scrum Master and/or delivery certification (PMP, CSM, PSM, or equivalent).
  • Experience facilitating planning and delivery ceremonies across more than one team or initiative.
  • Background working with cross-functional teams in a remote or hybrid environment.
  • Exposure to scaled Agile practices (SAFe, LeSS, or similar).
  • Relevant Industry Experience.

The successful candidate for this role will become an employee of Race Roster North America Corporation (doing business as ASICS Apps Canada), asubsidiary of ASICS Corporation, a Japanese multinational corporation. Race Roster was founded in London, Ontario in 2011.

We are a relentlessly client-focused group re-imagining, re-designing, and re-engineering the way electric utilities tackle industry problems. You are a technically deep transmission planning engineer with a track record of leading complex, multi-discipline power system studies from kickoff through final deliverable. You move fluidly between steady-state contingency analysis, transient stability, interconnection processes, and long-range buildout assessments without losing the thread.
