jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Developer
jobs.excerpt: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely.
jobs.description:
Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely.

Our platform, Qostodian, helps large organizations discover, classify, govern, and remediate sensitive unstructured data across their most critical data sources without moving or copying the data. This zero copy architecture reduces exposure, preserves data sovereignty, and allows enterprises to secure data directly where it lives.

This matters because AI adoption is increasing the risk, complexity, and urgency of enterprise data security. Before organizations can safely deploy AI agents, copilots, retrieval systems, or automated workflows, they need to know where sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, and how to enforce controls at scale.

Company culture is at our core

Our 5 core values are more than just words, they are a way of life for us. We know that companies with a strong culture and a higher purpose perform better in the long run.

Do our values speak to you?

  • Pursuit of excellence
  • Resilience
  • Mission focus
  • Accountability
  • Embracing conflict

About the team

We are standing up a new team for the QSIDS (Qohash Sensitive Information Detection System) launch, dedicated to the detection engine. A central focus of this team is the integration of embedded AI, machine learning models that run directly on the device and in-system. It is about high-performance, low-resource, on-device inference, embedded into the detection engine itself. The engine is built in Go, with a strong emphasis on performance and minimal resource footprint.

Who you are

You're a hands-on machine learning developer who's energized by getting models out of the notebook and into the real world, shipped, running, and holding up under production conditions. You take pride in owning what you build: watching how your models behave once deployed and iterating to keep them sharp. You bring strong engineering fundamentals and collaborate naturally, helping the team converge on quality decisions. You're comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a startup, and you care about the outcome, not just the code.

What You Will Do

  • Build, optimize, and embed machine learning models for on-device inference within the QSIDS detection engine.
  • Optimize models for performance and resource constraints, minimizing memory footprint, latency, and compute on-device.
  • Collaborate closely with systems engineers to integrate models efficiently into a Go-based engine.
  • Take models all the way to production and own them once they're running, monitoring performance, detecting drift, and iterating to keep them reliable.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define milestones and ensure timelines align with development needs.
  • Participate in discussions on technological choices and decisions regarding product development.
  • Resolve anomalies and problems as soon as they arise.
  • Stay on the lookout for the latest ML and other technologies and best practices - but resist novelty chasing.
  • Help onboard and train colleagues as the team grows.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What Your Resume Shows

Must Haves

  • 7+ years' experience building and shipping machine learning models to production- including deploying, running, and monitoring them in live environments
  • Hands-on track record owning models post-deployment: monitoring performance, detecting drift, and iterating on production systems
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience embedding ML models for on-device inference(a strong asset for this role)
  • Experience with high-performance, low-resource systems programming (memory management, multithreading, optimization), ideally in Go or an adjacent systems language
  • Bilingual (French and English)
  • Experience working in a startup environment
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive salary range.
  • Enjoy up to six weeks of paid time off annually, because we value your work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including:
    • Life insurance
    • Short- and long-term disability
    • Paramedical and telemedicine services
    • Health Spending Account (HSA)

Qohash is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. A working proficiency in English is required for this position based on the company's operational requirements. Only those candidates selected for interview will be contacted.

As our new Legal Counsel, you will play a key part in supporting Altus Group's public company obligations, strategic transactions, and long-term growth initiatives. Working closely with Finance, Corporate Development, senior leadership, and external advisors, you will provide legal support on matters that directly influence the company's strategy, growth, and market presence. You will contribute to acquisitions, divestitures, minority investments, public company disclosure obligations, corporate governance initiatives, and treasury-related matters.

This is an existing remote first role based out of Toronto or Montreal. Occasional in-person attendance may be required for team meetings and key business activities.

What’s in it for you

Work at the centre of growth and transformation. You will play a hands-on role in acquisitions, divestitures, minority investments, public company disclosure, corporate governance, and treasury-related matters. This is an opportunity to work on complex legal issues and strategic transactions that directly influence the growth, strategy, and market position of a global public company.

A seat at the table. You will partner closely with Finance, Corporate Development, Investor Relations, executive leadership, and external advisors, providing legal guidance on matters that shape business decisions. Beyond supporting transactions and compliance obligations, you will gain insight into the commercial, strategic, and operational considerations that drive the business and have the opportunity to contribute ideas that improve how work gets done.

A compelling next step for a corporate, securities, or M&A lawyer. Whether you are currently in private practice or already working in-house, this role offers the opportunity to remain deeply engaged in sophisticated transactional and public company work while broadening your business exposure and influence. With multiple levels of progression within the legal function and a culture that values initiative, ownership, and growth, there is significant opportunity to expand your scope and advance your career over time.

As our new Legal Counsel, you will:

  • Support strategic transactions.You will play a key role in acquisitions, divestitures, minority investments, and other corporate transactions, partnering with Corporate Development, Finance, external counsel, and business leaders to support due diligence, negotiate transaction documents, manage legal risks, and help drive successful outcomes.

  • Advise on securities and corporate governance matters.You will support Altus Group's public company obligations, including continuous disclosure requirements, regulatory filings, corporate governance initiatives, and Board and Committee materials. You will help ensure compliance with applicable securities laws and stock exchange requirements while contributing to strong governance practices across the organization.

  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership. You will work closely with Finance, Investor Relations, senior leadership, and external advisors on matters related to financial reporting, earnings releases, treasury activities, equity compensation programs, and other initiatives that directly influence the company's strategy, growth, and market presence.

  • Provide practical legal guidance.You will identify legal and regulatory risks, evaluate business implications, and provide thoughtful, commercially minded advice that supports decision-making while protecting the interests of the organization.

  • Support the company's global operations.You will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions, coordinating with external counsel and business leaders on corporate, governance, and transactional matters that support Altus Group's global operations and growth strategy.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement. You will help strengthen legal processes, corporate policies, governance practices, and documentation standards while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, manage risk, and support the evolving needs of the business.

  • Build trusted relationships across the organization. You will act as a collaborative partner to leaders across Legal, Finance, Corporate Development, Investor Relations, and the broader business, bringing sound judgment, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.

You bring:

  • The legal foundation. You have a J.D. or LL.B. and are called to the Bar in a Canadian province. You have built your experience within a leading law firm, a public company, or a combination of both, and are looking for an opportunity to apply your expertise within a collaborative, business-focused environment.

  • The securities and corporate governance expertise.You have experience supporting public company disclosure obligations, corporate governance initiatives, and securities compliance matters. You are comfortable reviewing disclosure documents, interpreting regulatory requirements, and working with securities regulators and stock exchanges.

  • The transaction experience.You have worked on mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, investments, or other corporate transactions and understand the legal, commercial, and operational considerations involved. You have experience reviewing and negotiating transaction documents, supporting due diligence activities, and managing competing priorities in fast-moving environments.

  • The business judgment.You can identify legal and regulatory risks while balancing commercial objectives and practical realities. You understand that the best legal advice is not only technically sound but also actionable, pragmatic, and aligned with business goals.

  • The ownership mindset.You are proactive, responsive, and highly organized. You take accountability for your work, manage competing priorities effectively, and can be trusted to drive matters forward independently while knowing when to seek guidance or escalate issues.

  • The curiosity and drive.You enjoy complex, intellectually challenging work and are motivated by the opportunity to contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities. You ask thoughtful questions, bring forward ideas, and are interested in understanding how legal decisions influence the broader business.

Apply now

  • A meet and greet with key business partners and senior leaders focused on collaboration, communication, and your ability to operate effectively within a fast-paced, business-focused environment. This stage will also provide an opportunity to learn more about the broader organization and the stakeholders you would work with most closely.

Unlock your Altus Experience!

About Arlo:

At Arlo, we're passionate about creating innovative and reliable solutions that help people protect what matters most to them. Our team is dedicated to delivering products that exceed our customers' expectations, while always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of protection technology. We believe that everyone deserves to feel safe and secure, whether they're at home or away, and we're committed to providing our customers with the peace of mind they need to live their lives without worry. Arlo’s deep expertise in AI- and CV-powered analytics, cloud services, user experience, product design, and innovative wireless and RF connectivity enables the delivery of a seamless, smart security experience for Arlo users that is easy to set up and interact with every day.

Arlo is looking for an experienced commercial account director to join our team supporting our growing portfolio of strategic accounts that use Arlo’s industry-leading SaaS platform to deploy smart security solutions. In this critical role, you will be the primary owner of Arlo’s most commercially significant partnerships — responsible not just for managing relationships, but for building the governance model and commercial operating framework through which Arlo delivers on its largest, most complex partner commitments.

Sitting at the intersection of commercial strategy and program delivery, you will own the full partnership lifecycle: from commercial framework and launch readiness through to sustained performance and long-term growth. You will define how Arlo organizes and governs large strategic accounts — creating the repeatable playbook that scales — while maintaining direct accountability for the revenue outcomes, delivery execution, and relationship health of the partnerships in your portfolio.

This role requires someone with demonstrated success managing enterprise accounts with a fast-growing book of business: managing complex, multi-workstream service provider partnerships at enterprise scale, owning a revenue number, and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver consistently and at scale.

Core Responsibilities

Commercial Ownership & Revenue Accountability

  • Own full accountability for forecasted revenue and commercial outcomes across your partnership portfolio, with direct reporting visibility to Arlo senior leadership
  • Build and maintain commercial models that track partnership performance against plan
  • Define and negotiate commercial frameworks, SOW terms, and performance milestones that align partner commitments with Arlo’s revenue objectives
  • Identify and develop opportunities to grow commercial scope within existing partnerships, deepening Arlo’s value proposition, driving retention, and expanding the engagement footprint

Account Governance & Delivery Architecture

  • Define and implement the governance model for how Arlo manages large strategic accounts — building a repeatable, scalable playbook covering stakeholder alignment, workstream management, escalation protocols, and performance reporting
  • Own program governance structures across engineering, product, operations, legal, and commercial workstreams — ensuring Arlo can consistently deliver on complex, multi-year partner commitments
  • Establish clear cross-functional accountability frameworks across all internal teams engaged on a given partnership: clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths, so that commitments made to partners are commitments kept
  • Drive continuous improvement of Arlo’s partnership success model — capturing learning from each partnership cycle and building institutional best practice that others can apply and build on

Cross-Functional Leadership & Launch Readiness

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Legal to deliver on partnership commitments and ensure readiness for commercial launches
  • Define and manage commercial timelines, dependencies, and escalations across multiple concurrent workstreams, maintaining pace and accountability throughout
  • Ensure Arlo presents a single, consistent voice to its partners — with internal positions aligned and commitments validated before they reach the partner
  • Design & deliver partnership success systems to enable Arlo to scale its partner delivery capacity without proportional increases in management overhead

Stakeholder Management & Executive Relationships

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
  • Provide regular, structured updates to Arlo leadership on partnership health, revenue trajectory, launch progress, and risk and opportunity areas
  • Operate effectively across technical and commercial contexts — translating engineering and product complexity into commercial clarity for executive audiences, and surfacing commercial context to technical teams
  • Represent Arlo’s partner interests internally with authority, ensuring partner-facing commitments are understood and resourced across all contributing teams

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10–15 years of experience in strategic partnerships, account management, or a related field — ideally in SaaS, IoT, smart home, or connected security
  • Demonstrated track record of owning revenue outcomes in complex, high-value service provider partnerships — not just managing relationships, but holding and delivering against a commercial number
  • Proven experience designing and implementing partnership success frameworks for large strategic accounts — with experience in building the operating model, not just working within one
  • Proven track record delivering large-scale platform integrations or commercial programs in B2B2C or service provider environments
  • Experience managing across multiple disciplines — engineering, product, operations, marketing, legal, and commercial — in a matrixed, cross-functional environment
  • Strong executive presence — credible with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders both internally and at partner organizations, able to operate as a peer at the most senior levels
  • Decisive and outcomes-oriented — able to assess situations quickly, build alignment, and drive action in fast-moving environments
  • High levels of personal accountability and ownership; a self-starter who sets the standard for others and operates effectively with significant autonomy
  • Experience in large-scale service provider environments (cable, MSO, security, or telco) is a requirement for this role, not a preference
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent a plus
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50%

The pay range for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries at commencement of employment and is expected to be between $170,000 - $220,000/year, plus equity. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including location, role, job-related knowledge, skills, relevant education and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including bonus, equity, and a full range of benefits. Details of all benefits will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

We’re committed to inclusivity and selecting the strongest candidate—no matter their background. Even if you don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. Remote | Full-time ContractorPreferred location: Latin America (Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina) Portfolio or GitHub required

A fast-growing North American manufacturer of premium window and door systems is hiring a Senior Product Engineer to own the development of internal tools, a public-facing website, and — most critically — a high-performance interactive 3D product visualization platform built from scratch.

This is a high-ownership, solo-contributor role. You will design and ship real systems end-to-end, working directly with leadership. There is no engineering team beneath you. If you enjoy full ownership and building systems that teams and customers rely on every day, this role is for you.

Compensation

  • Contractor Monthly Salary in USD payment via Deel

  • Fully remote, flexible working hours

  • Paid monthly via international contractor payment

  • We cover the cost of any developer or AI tools you need (Claude, Cursor, Codex, etc.)

  • Top candidates will have the opportunity to grow with the engineering team as it expands

About the Company

A privately held manufacturer with operations across North America, specializing in premium architectural window and door systems. The company designs and builds its own products and is now developing the internal software platforms, visualization tools, and digital experiences that will power its next stage of growth. The engineering team is small, the decisions move fast, and the person in this role will have direct impact on how the company operates and sells.

What You'll Build

🪟 Product Visualization Platform (primary focus)

You will build from scratch an interactive, web-based 3D visualization tool that allows customers to configure and explore complex architectural products. This is the most technically demanding part of the role.

Requirements:

  • True 3D rendering — no 2D models stacked on separate planes

  • Correct pivot point calculations for product movement and mechanical behavior

  • Toggle between styles, colors, materials, and sizes with parametric scaling

  • Texture and model compression for sub-second load times — "send the recipe, not the dish"

  • Smooth real-time rendering as product options are changed

  • Integration between UI state and the visualization engine

The 3D assets will be provided by designers. Your focus is engineering, architecture, and performance.

Note on background: We're especially interested in candidates with experience in gaming or game engine environments (Unity, Unreal, etc.) — not because the tool must be built on a game engine, but because that background produces engineers who think in 3D transformations, physics, and optimized rendering. That said, any engineer who can demonstrably build a performant 3D configurator will be considered.

🛠️ Internal Tools

Software used daily by teams across sales, marketing, and production:

  • Production workflow and scheduling dashboards

  • Sales and marketing analytics tools

  • Automation connectors between internal systems and APIs

🌐 Website Platform

  • Maintain and evolve the public-facing website (currently on Webflow)

  • Build product and landing pages

  • Integrate the visualization tool into the website

  • Performance-optimized frontend architecture and SEO

Tech Stack

LayerTechnologiesFrontendReact (TypeScript), Tailwind CSSVisualizationThree.js / WebGL, D3.js, SVG / Canvas, ECharts / RechartsBackendNode.js or Python, REST APIs, SQL databasesInfrastructureAWS (EC2, RDS, S3), CI/CD pipelines, Docker (nice to have)CMS/WebsiteWebflow3D FormatsOBJ and similar; texture + model compression pipelines

AI-Native Development

The team actively uses AI tools as force multipliers and expects you to do the same:

  • Claude, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor

  • AI-assisted IDE workflows for code generation, refactoring, and debugging

  • All tools will be covered. Candidates already working AI-natively are a strong plus.

What We're Looking For

Must-have:

  • 4+ years of full-stack engineering experience

  • Strong JavaScript / TypeScript

  • Experience building and shipping production web applications independently

  • Ability to own projects end-to-end with no hand-holding

  • Strong communication: proactive updates, early escalation of blockers, sense of urgency on bugs

  • Remote-first discipline: available Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm EST for collaborative hours

Strong plus:

  • Experience with Three.js, WebGL, or any real-time 3D rendering framework

  • Background in gaming development (Unity, Unreal, or similar)

  • Experience building product configurators or interactive visualization tools

  • Familiarity with 3D model compression and optimization (LOD, texture atlasing, etc.)

Most important: you can show us something you built yourself — and it works.

How We Work

  • Small team, direct access to decision-makers

  • Projects move fast and are often built from scratch

  • Communication is frank, proactive, and async-friendly

  • Mistakes are fine — hiding them is not

  • We're problem-solvers: bring issues early and we'll solve them together

Hiring Process

  1. Portfolio / GitHub review(resumes alone will not be considered)

  2. Short technical conversation

  3. Paid trial project (4–8 hours): a real problem similar to the role — we pay for your time. Strong candidates may also be asked to walk through how they'd optimize a 3D file's load time and rendering pipeline.

  • Build financial models in Excel to support valuation analysis; ensure models are accurate, well-documented, and defensible under diligence scrutiny.
  • Draft offer letters, term sheets, and deal documents; lead or participate in negotiation of deal terms, drawing on a clear understanding of CSI / Andromeda's buy-box criteria.
  • Coordinate the due diligence process through to closing — managing multiple internal and external workstreams (legal, financial, operational, IT) simultaneously and keeping all parties aligned on timelines and deliverables.

Target Relationship Management:

  • Maintain high-quality, ongoing relationships with decision-makers at acquisition targets throughout the deal lifecycle — from first contact through post-close.
  • Represent Andromeda well in every external interaction; exercise professional judgement and polish when engaging with business owners, investment bankers, legal counsel, and accountants on behalf of the Boson team.
  • Communicate clearly and succinctly with external counterparties, tailoring the level of detail and tone to the audience — from owner-operated SMEs to sophisticated institutional intermediaries.
  • Surface issues and relationship dynamics early so the VP of M&A and EVP of Finance can make informed decisions without surprises.

Financial Oversight of Acquired Business Unit:

  • As needed, provide financial and accounting oversight of MENA-region BUs following acquisition, ensuring continuity and accuracy of reporting at both the unit and group level.
  • Facilitate finance integration of newly acquired businesses — working collaboratively with BU finance leads and the Boson portfolio team to establish reporting cadences, controls, and processes consistent with Andromeda standards.
  • Identify integration risks early and escalate with a proposed path forward; bring a problem-solving orientation to post-close challenges rather than waiting for direction.

Team Contribution and Knowledge Sharing:

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and oversight to junior M&A Execution team members as the Boson team grows; share what you know, make onboarding easier for others, and set a high bar for work quality through example.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Andromeda's M&A processes and tools — flagging what is working and what is not, and helping refine diligence frameworks over time.
  • Collaborate with the broader Andromeda Home Office and IMO functions as required, sharing insights on regional market dynamics and target characteristics that improve portfolio-level decision-making.
  • Bring constructive energy and intellectual curiosity to team discussions; be the kind of colleague who raises questions, surfaces ideas, and makes the team's collective work stronger.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is required.
  • CPA / CA designation, CFA, and/or MBA are strong assets and will be considered favourably.

Experience:

  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience at a top-tier accounting firm, capital advisory firm, investment bank, and/or private equity firm.
  • 3–5 years of mid-market deal experience executing transactions end-to-end is mandatory; candidates without direct deal execution experience will not be considered.
  • 5+ years in a financial controller and/or financial management role is mandatory.
  • Demonstrated experience working with small, owner-managed businesses as a client or acquisition target.
  • Buy-side experience is a plus but not required.

Skills & Attributes:

  • Advanced Excel proficiency and exceptional financial modelling skills; able to build, stress-test, and explain a detailed valuation model independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write clear, succinct reports and present analysis confidently to senior executives, business owners, and professional advisors.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities simultaneously without compromising accuracy.
  • Confidence and professional polish in frequent interaction with Senior Executives, Business Owners, Investment Bankers, Lawyers, Accountants, and other key stakeholders.

What makes the role unique:

It is a high-ownership individual contributor position within a growing regional platform, where the Associate Director / Director takes genuine end-to-end responsibility for deal execution and leaves behind a track record of closed transactions and integrated businesses. jobs.title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
jobs.excerpt: You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company.
jobs.description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Your Responsibilities :

  • Design and build the gRPC services at the heart of the Cloud Portal, APIs that other teams depend on and that must stay compatible as the platform grows

  • Take services end to end: design, ship, and run them in production, across both cloud and on-prem

  • Solve the performance and scaling problems that come with multi-tenant systems and large datasets

  • Help shape architecture and technical direction, where your input genuinely moves things in a team this small

Requirements

  • 5+ years writing production-grade Go

  • Strong grasp of idiomatic Go, concurrency patterns, and profiling with pprof, plus a real understanding of escape analysis, allocation behavior, and what the GC is actually doing

  • Solid experience building and maintaining APIs using gRPC, including Protobuf versioning, streaming, and API lifecycle best practices (bonus: you know Google AIPs)

  • Proven experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), performance tuning, and schema design

jobs.title: Jurilex - Letselschade expert
jobs.excerpt: Ben jij een ervaren jurist die klaar is voor de volgende stap in je carrière?
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren jurist die klaar is voor de volgende stap in je carrière? En wil je de vrijheid om je eigen letselschadepraktijk op te zetten, terwijl je profiteert van een sterk netwerk en ondersteuning? Bij Jurilex Letselschade bieden we jou de unieke kans om zelfstandig te werken en tegelijkertijd samen te ondernemen. Ontdek wat wij jou te bieden hebben!

Wie is Jurilex?

Jurilex Letselschade is een toonaangevende organisatie gespecialiseerd in belangenbehartiging voor letselschadeslachtoffers. Ons team bestaat uit ervaren juristen, (register)experts, arbeidsdeskundigen en medisch adviseurs die slachtoffers ondersteunen bij het opstellen en onderbouwen van vorderingen tegen aansprakelijke partijen. Dankzij jarenlange ervaring is Jurilex Letselschade een krachtige onderhandelingspartner die voor een rechtvaardige schadevergoeding zorgt.

Onze organisatie is aangesloten bij het Nationaal Keurmerk Letselschade, waarmee we voldoen aan strenge kwaliteitsnormen. Jurilex biedt letselschadeslachtoffers kosteloze hulp, waarbij de juridische kosten worden verhaald op de tegenpartij. Met een landelijk netwerk van specialisten staan wij altijd klaar om slachtoffers de best mogelijke ondersteuning te bieden.

Wat bieden wij?

Wij bieden jou de unieke kans om je eigen letselschadepraktijk op te zetten en zelfstandig te werken, terwijl je samen onderneemt binnen een ondersteunend netwerk. Bij Jurilex ben je als Senior Jurist Letselschade verantwoordelijk voor je eigen praktijk, met de zekerheid van voldoende zaken en een solide reputatie die we in 20 jaar hebben opgebouwd.

  • Je hoeft geen cliënten te werven; de volledige acquisitie wordt voor jou gedaan en alle aanvragen komen centraal binnen en worden jou aangedragen door de interne intakejuristen;
  • Je bent geen entree fee verschuldigd, wat de start van je praktijk financieel aantrekkelijk maakt;
  • Je totale financiële administratie wordt indien gewenst tegen interne kosten voor je gedaan, zodat je je kunt richten op de inhoud van je werk;
  • Je werkt in je eigen regio; soms moet je iets verder weg naar een cliënt, maar dat wordt zoveel mogelijk vermeden;
  • Er zijn geen omzet- of ureneisen, zodat je lekker zelfstandig kunt werken en jouw eigen keuzes kunt maken;
  • Jouw afdracht aan de organisatie bedraagt slechts 40% van de door jou gerealiseerde omzet;
  • Je werkt in een omgeving waarin je er nooit alleen voor staat, met ruimte voor collegiaal overleg en persoonlijke ontwikkeling;
  • Je hebt de vrijheid om jouw eigen letselschadekantoor te beheren, je agenda zelf te bepalen en in jouw regio te werken;
  • Je kunt reële verdiensten realiseren van € 150.000 tot meer dan € 200.000 bruto per jaar bij circa 1.000 tot 1.250 uur;
  • Er worden je interne opleidingen aangeboden zonder dat je hiervoor kosten hoeft te maken, zodat je altijd up-to-date blijft en kosteloos PE-punten verzamelt;
  • Je kunt volledige ondersteuning krijgen van een notaris voor de oprichting van jouw eigen onderneming en de aangesloten bank voor het openen van zakelijke rekeningen;
  • Voorts kun je gebruik maken van de externe IT-partners waar wij mee werken, zodat je zorgeloos digitaal kunt werken;
  • Je kunt je aansluiten bij de collectieve beroepsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering en AVB, waarmee je meer dan 80% op de kosten bespaart.

Requirements

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken gedreven professionals die beschikken over de juiste kwalificaties en ervaring om ons team te versterken in de letselschaderegeling. Je hebt een passie voor het ondersteunen van slachtoffers en het behalen van een rechtvaardige compensatie voor hun schade.

Wij zoeken wij iemand die:

  • beschikt over een afgeronde wo-opleiding rechtsgeleerdheid of vergelijkbaar;
  • de NIVRE opleiding (bijna) heeft afgerond;
  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring heeft in de letselschaderegeling;
  • over uitstekende communcatieve en sociale vaardigheden beschikt om effectief te kunnen samenwerken met diverse partijen;
  • in bezit is van een rijbewijs B;
  • bereid is een eigen praktijk te draaien;
  • ondernemend is;
  • empathisch is en zich goed kan inleven in de situatie van het slachtoffer;
  • flexibel en creatief is in zijn of haar aanpak, omdat elke letselschadezaak uniek is en buiten de kaders denken noodzakelijk kan zijn.

Als Senior CRM / Lifecycle Manager (m/w/d) treibst Du das Herzstück unserer Wachstumsstrategie voran: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Player Journey nach der Akquisition und transformierst App-Installationen und Erstspieler in begeisterte, loyale und wertvolle Nutzer. Mit CleverTap als Deiner Schaltzentrale konzipierst und steuerst Du datengetriebene Multi-Channel-Kampagnen über Push, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging. Dein klares Ziel: Die Retention-Kurve und den Player Lifetime Value auf ein neues Level zu heben, Churn konsequent zu minimieren und jeden in das Marketing investierten Euro durch eine meisterhafte Bindungsstrategie maximal zu hebeln.

Auf den Punkt gebrach -> Du baust das fundamentale Lifecycle-Programm von Grund auf auf, schützt den Wert unserer expandierenden Nutzerbasis und machst sie nachhaltig zu unserem größten Wachstumsmotor!

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

  • Kampagnenmanagement: Operative Steuerung und Optimierung der täglichen Lifecycle-Kampagnen über Push-Benachrichtigungen, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging in CleverTap.

  • Journey-Automatisierung: Konzeption, Umsetzung und Betreuung automatisierter Journeys entlang der Phasen Onboarding, Aktivierung, Retention, Winback und Monetarisierung.

  • Zielgerichtete Segmentierung: Entwicklung verhaltens- und lifecycle-basierter Segmentierungs- und Targeting-Logiken zur Sicherstellung der optimalen Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt.

  • A/B-Testing & Optimierung: Systematische Durchführung von A/B-Tests hinsichtlich Messaging, Timing, Kanal und Angeboten (Offers) inklusive fortlaufender Dokumentation der Learnings.

  • Reporting & Analytics: Analyse von Retention-Kurven, Kohorten, Engagement, Churn sowie des LTVs und Aufbau passender Dashboards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data-Team.

  • Strategische End-to-End-Verantwortung: Strategische Steuerung der Post-Acquisition Player Journey und ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den gesamten Lifecycle-Funnel.

  • Interdisziplinäre Schnittstellenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung und Koordination gemeinsamer Initiativen mit den Teams aus Marketing, User Acquisition, Social Media, Data und Product.

  • Compliance & Responsible Gaming: Sicherstellung aller relevanten Compliance-Anforderungen (insb. GlüStV) sowie Berücksichtigung von Responsible-Gaming-Prinzipien und spezifischen Kommunikationsrichtlinien im Lotterieumfeld.

🚀 Deine Kompetenzen

Must-have:

  • Berufserfahrung: 3–5 Jahre fundierte Praxiserfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing im B2C-App- oder Consumer-Product-Umfeld.

  • Tool-Expertise: Tiefgehende, praktische Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation-Plattformen (z. B. CleverTap, Braze, Leanplum, Iterable, MoEngage) inklusive der eigenständigen technischen Umsetzung von Kampagnen.

  • Mobile-Kommunikation: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der kanalübergreifenden Mobile-Kommunikation via Push-Notifications, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging.

  • Journey-Konzeption: Fundierte Kenntnisse in verhaltensbasierter Segmentierung sowie in der End-to-End-Entwicklung und dem Rollout mehrstufiger, automatisierter Customer Journeys.

  • Testing-Mentalität: Praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Auswertung und iterativen Optimierung von A/B-Tests und Experimenten.

  • Analytische Stärke: Sicherer Umgang mit Product-Analytics-Tools (z. B. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), im Aufbau von Dashboards sowie in der Analyse von Tabellenmodellen, Retention-Kurven und Kohorten.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Flying Bisons, we’re building Europe’s leading Strategic Design & Implementation consultancy — delivering the quality, rigor, and impact you’d expect from top-tier consulting firms, but fully specialized in digital products and transformation. With a rapidly growing presence in the Middle East, we partner with enterprises and governments on their most high-stakes initiatives, shaping platforms and services used by tens of millions of people.

Our work directly influences how millions of people around the globe live, work, and interact with digital services.

  • Public Platforms — defining how 15+ million citizens and 1+ million businesses interact with the labor market in Saudi Arabia.

  • Banking & Finance — building digital platforms for the largest banks in Europe and Saudi Arabia.

  • Telecommunications — shaping customer experiences for telcos with a combined 150+ million subscribers.

  • Education — working with the Ministry of Education in Saudi Arabia, the largest ministry in the country, on its digital transformation.

  • Media — partnering with leading media platforms in Poland and Europe with a total reach of tens of millions.

  • Consumer & Retail — from KFC and Hebe to NaTemat and Enel-Med, creating products used daily by millions.

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos — Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design — design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90% — the Invisible 90% — is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design — and we want you to be part of it.

That’s why we’re looking for a Project Manager who thinks systemically, acts proactively, and can maintain structure even in complex projects.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and experienced IT Project Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our operations, bridging the gap between client needs and our internal, cross-functional teams. You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of digital projects, with a specific focus on serving and growing our portfolio of clients in the Middle East (MENA region). You will be responsible for delivery, profitability, and fostering strong, long-lasting relationships with our partners.

This is more than just a task-management role; we are looking for a true owner who can navigate the complexities of project execution, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the evolution of our AI-first project management processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Order Management & Business Development:

    • Create and manage work orders based on client requirements and team capacity

    • Prepare compelling business proposals based on client needs and profitability calculations

    • Proactively manage delivery timelines and ensure smooth order processing

    • Identify upsell opportunities and think strategically about expanding our partnerships

  • Team & Resource Management:

    • Monitor team capacity and allocate resources effectively across projects

    • Plan for substitutions and manage ad-hoc changes within the team

    • Support the onboarding and offboarding of team members (access, approvals, NDAs)

  • Financial & Administrative Oversight:

    • Supervise the accuracy of data in billing systems and support the invoicing process

    • Monitor budget utilization and track hours worked against allocated budgets

    • Communicate discrepancies and issues promptly, and monitor client receivables

  • Project Execution & Quality:

    • Act as the primary point of contact for clients and internal teams (Analytics, Design, Dev, etc.)

    • Gather and structure project status updates from stream leaders to ensure clear data flow

    • Actively support the resolution of daily project issues and manage pressure effectively

    • Support quality control for strategically important deliverables

    • Manage projects using agile methodologies (1-2 week sprints) within Jira and other PM tools

  • Stakeholder & Risk Management:

    • Build and nurture relationships with partners, with a deep understanding of the cultural and business specifics of clients from the MENA region

    • Proactively manage risks, including availability during holidays and breaks across our team, vendors, and clients

    • Communicate effectively to keep all stakeholders aligned on project goals

  • Process Improvement:

    • Constantly engage in the development of tools and processes to support AI-first project management

What You Bring to the Table

  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years in project management, preferably within a digital agency or tech environment delivering products involving UX/UI design, development, and research

  • Middle East Focus: Must have prior experience working directly with clients from the Middle East (MENA region) and a solid understanding of the business culture

  • Technical & Methodological Knowledge: Strong familiarity with project management software, especially Jira and time-tracking tools (experience with Productive is a plus). Solid understanding of modern technology capabilities and constraints

  • Communication: Proficiency in both written and spoken Polish and English (C1/C2 level) . Excellent communication skills to manage client expectations and align internal teams

  • Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams of 10-15 members with a product-focused mindset. You take full responsibility for project execution and are a proactive, solution-oriented problem solver

  • Business Acumen: A knack for identifying business opportunities and a strong understanding of budget management, profitability, and reporting

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to manage challenging, high-impact projects for international clients

  • Work in a dynamic, AI-first environment where you can help shape the tools and processes of tomorrow

  • Collaborative culture with a focus on professional growth and tackling ambitious projects

We're looking for a full time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.

About Intellect

Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. We're a team of psychologists, clinicians, and technologists providing an evidence-based approach to proactively help anyone, no matter where they are on their mental health journey. Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative & relatable, and stigma-free. Join us on our mission to reinvent how mental healthcare is being delivered

  • Make a quick in-the-moment decision on how to move forward if the responder is not sure how to proceed

Requirements

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases)
  • Has the appropriate insurances required by your country
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk cases

Plus Points if you:

  • have a background in mental health or emergency services
  • can effectively communicate in more than 1 language
  • maintain professional indemnity insurance

We're looking for a full time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.

About Intellect

Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. Requirements

  • Preferrably with Master's Degree in Psychology/Counselling or relevant field
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases)
  • Has the appropriate insurances required by your country
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk cases

  • have a background in mental health or emergency services
  • can effectively communicate in more than 1 language
  • maintain professional indemnity insurance

As a Crisis Helpline Responder, you’ll provide immediate support and guidance to individuals in crisis, offering compassionate listening, crisis intervention, and critical referral services to help callers navigate their most challenging moments.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a part time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a part time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.

About Intellect

Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. We're a team of psychologists, clinicians, and technologists providing an evidence-based approach to proactively help anyone, no matter where they are on their mental health journey.Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative & relatable, and stigma-free. Join us on our mission to reinvent how mental healthcare is being delivered

Role & Responsibilities

  • Responding to telephone hotline for crisis support of those bereaved through suicide, engaging in self-harm, experiencing suicide ideation and concerned friends or family members.
  • Providing a range of evidenced based, professional crisis counselling services and personal support, employing de-escalation techniques and crisis intervention techniques
  • Assessing the caller's needs and triage for immediate safety or emergency medical attention of callers, or referrals to appropriate service referrals such as face-to-face crisis intervention, case management/advocacy services, individual therapy, or group services.
  • Maintaining accurate and detailed call reports on key issues and referrals actioned
  • Complying with responsibilities under the Data Protection Acts 1988, 2003 & 2018 (GDPR)
  • Supporting in the development of appropriate crisis management plans to support callers in crisis
  • Make a quick in-the-moment decision on how to move forward if the responder is not sure how to proceed
  • Ensuring smooth and diligent handover process to next shift personnel
  • Dedicating entire shift to intellect tasks and responsibilities only
  • Conducting risk assessments, including lethality assessment for suicide cases

Requirements

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Can effectively communicate in their native language
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases) and
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk case

Plus Points if you:

  • have a background in mental health or emergency services
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • can effectively communicate in more than 1 language
  • maintain professional indemnity insurance

We're looking for a full time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.

About Intellect

Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. We're a team of psychologists, clinicians, and technologists providing an evidence-based approach to proactively help anyone, no matter where they are on their mental health journey. Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative & relatable, and stigma-free. Join us on our mission to reinvent how mental healthcare is being delivered

Role & Responsibilities

  • Responding to telephone hotline for crisis support of those bereaved through suicide, engaging in self-harm, experiencing suicide ideation and concerned friends or family members.
  • Conducting risk assessments, including lethality assessment for suicide cases
  • Providing a range of evidenced based, professional crisis counselling services and personal support, employing de-escalation techniques and crisis intervention techniques
  • Assessing the caller's needs and triage for immediate safety or emergency medical attention of callers, or referrals to appropriate service referrals such as face-to-face crisis intervention, case management/advocacy services, individual therapy, or group services.
  • Maintaining accurate and detailed call reports on key issues and referrals actioned
  • Complying with responsibilities under the Data Protection Acts 1988, 2003 & 2018 (GDPR)
  • Supporting in the development of appropriate crisis management plans to support callers in crisis
  • Make a quick in-the-moment decision on how to move forward if the responder is not sure how to proceed

Requirements

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Preferrably with Master's Degree in Psychology/Counselling or relevant field
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases)
  • Has the appropriate insurances required by your country
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk cases

Plus Points if you:

  • have a background in mental health or emergency services
  • can effectively communicate in more than 1 language
  • maintain professional indemnity insurance

jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software and V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Special Projects team at Shield AI is an elite force within the office of the CTO. It consists of a group of very senior (L5-L8) and highly experienced software engineering experts from diverse fields (aerospace, robotics, cloud infrastructure, game development, interactive media design, ...). The charter of this group is to steer technology development towards strategic alignment with the CTO's vision, through tactical insertion into teams and technologies across the organization. Individuals within this team make direct and at times forward-sprinting contributions to all three pillars of Hivemind, Shield AI's software ecosystem for developing and deploying resilient intelligent teaming for aircrafts. Hivemind consists of four products: EdgeOS (C++ based high-performance middleware for autonomy development), Pilot (autonomy for the edge built atop EdgeOS; a models-based, modular and open architecture C++ codebase), Forge (Shield AI's AI Factory for the design, development, and testing of Hivemind Edge systems; a service-oriented architecture leveraged through an SDK, CLI, and web portal; a Go, Python, Typescript codebase), Commander (Software and hardware to support rich human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop interactions with the Hivemind; a C++-based back-end for interaction with Pilot; and a web-application UI for mission planning, command and control by operators implemented in a Typescript/React codebase).

The Special Projects team is chartered to operate effectively within ambiguity. While this team does not own any software products, it tactically and strategically impacts the development of all foundational Hivemind products and leverages those technologies to rapidly deliver low-TRL solutions. This work happens shoulder-to-shoulder with the product teams in some cases, and in a forward-sprinting manner within the Special Projects team in other cases. The result is direct contribution to products in the former case, and development of reference implementations in the latter. The Special Projects team also functions as a pipeline for product and solution engineering teams across the organization. Individuals who enter the Special Projects team rapidly gain depth and breadth in their understanding of the Hivemind software ecosystem. This positions them well for leading technology development effort across the product and solution organization.

What you'll do:

  • Own product definition, roadmap, and metrics across the office of the CTO's agentic AI portfolio: an enterprise knowledge assistant (Brain), an agent-driven engineering platform (Springboard), and enterprise AI/data modernization and app development.
  • Translate CTO strategy into crisp requirements, milestones, exit criteria, and KPIs — then hold the line on them.
  • Drive adoption of internal platforms: reduce onboarding friction, instrument usage, track NPS and active users, and run developer advocacy and objection handling.
  • Shape product direction for foundation-model based autonomy architectures and model lifecycle tooling (evaluation, fine-tuning, verification, deployment).
  • Run continuous discovery with engineers, operators, and executive stakeholders; turn findings into prioritized backlogs.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly across competing initiatives with small teams and aggressive timelines.
  • Analyze the agentic tooling, enterprise AI platform, and foundation model ecosystem; recommend build/buy/partner positions to leadership.
  • Author strategy documents, product briefs, and executive updates that drive decisions.
  • Manage transitions of maturing products from incubation to owning organizations.

Required qualifications:

  • 8+ years of product management for deeply technical products; engineering or CS background.
  • Technical fluency: you read code, work APIs and CLIs from a terminal, and prototype with AI coding tools yourself.
  • Shipped developer tools, internal platforms, or AI/ML products — and drove their adoption.
  • Working fluency in LLM-based systems: agents, evaluation, context management, fine-tuning trade-offs.
  • Metrics-driven operating style: you define KPIs, instrument products, and report against thresholds and objectives.
  • Exceptional written communication — requirements, strategy docs, executive briefs.
  • Proven stakeholder management up to the executive level across engineering, product, and business functions.
  • Fluid intelligence that allows one to operate effectively in ambiguous conditions while finding opportunities to drive technical efforts and force multiply.
  • This role requires travel to a Shield AI location 1-3 times per quarter

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience as a software engineer.
  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or other regulated environments (CUI/ITAR, restricted or disconnected deployments).
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms (e.g. Databricks) and ERP/business-system integration.
  • Experience with safety-critical or assurance-driven software processes (requirements traceability, V&V, certification artifacts).
  • Experience taking zero-to-one internal products through incubation, adoption, and handoff.
  • Experience with robotics or autonomy products.

jobs.description:
Title: Sr. People Technology Integration Specialist

Reports To: Director, People Operations & Technology

Location: India

About Us

HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, including agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our People

With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who Are You

The People Technology Integration Specialist is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining secure, scalable integrations across the People Technology ecosystem. This role acts as the technical backbone of interoperability between Darwinbox and external platforms (ADP, Netsuite, Snowflake, Shareworks, Slack, etc.), ensuring clean data flow, schema governance, and operational continuity.

Unlike configuration-heavy roles, this position requires strong integration architecture thinking combined with hands-on execution across APIs, data mapping, transformation logic, and validation frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integration Architecture & Design

  • Define Integration Blueprint: Design end-to-end integration architecture across the People Technology ecosystem - connecting Darwinbox with IT, Payroll, FP&A, Equity, EOR (Employer of Record) systems and other complementing platforms; ensuring scalability, compliance, and a seamless experience across the employee lifecycle.
  • Data Mapping & Schema Governance: Own field-level mapping, transformation logic, code harmonization (e.g., cost centers, departments, job codes), and schema documentation across all integrated systems.
  • Business-to-Technical Translation: Translate Functional requirements into structured integration specifications with clearly defined data contracts that serve downstream consumers.
    •

2. API Configuration & Data Flow Management

  • API & Middleware Configuration: Configure and manage Darwinbox APIs, webhooks, SFTP feeds, and Amplify scripts to ensure secure, accurate, and timely data transformations and transfers across the ecosystem.
  • Build & Maintain Analytics-Ready Feeds: Design statistical and headcount feeds into Snowflake and financial planning feeds into Abacum, ensuring aggregation logic is compliant, audit-safe, and structured for downstream consumption.
  • Integration Enhancements: Maintain and enhance integrations by leveraging lifecycle event triggers, eligibility syncs, and reconciliation workflows.
  • Environment & Version Control: Manage sandbox vs. production configurations, schema versioning, and release readiness across all integration environments.
    •

3. Monitoring, Controls & Incident Management

  • Proactive Monitoring: Monitor daily integration syncs, overnight jobs, and scheduled feeds across all connected platforms for failures or discrepancies.
  • Exception Handling & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and resolve integration failures (e.g., invalid codes, duplicate IDs, missing mandatory fields) with a focus on preventing recurrence across the ecosystem.
  • Audit & ITGC Compliance: Ensure maker-checker controls, validation logs, and change management documentation are maintained for compliance and audit purposes across all integrated systems.
    •

4. Data Integrity & Cross-System Alignment

  • Master Data Governance: Ensure consistency of core attributes across Darwinbox and all downstream systems.

Director, Business Development & State Engagement

This role partners closely with Programs, Business Development, and cross‑functional teams to anticipate procurement cycles, support RFP readiness, and position CAI’s products and services for successful adoption and long‑term impact.

Through strategic engagement, coordination, and clear communication, the Director connects state education needs with CAI’s capabilities to expand market opportunities and support sustained program success.

Job Responsibilities:

State Relationship Management & Business Development

  • Strategic Relationship Building — Cultivate and maintain exceptional relationships with state education agency leaders, district leaders, and key stakeholders to support business development, renewals, and program expansion.

  • Business & Procurement Alignment — Implement state‑level engagement and procurement strategies that support adoption and sustained use of CAI’s products and services in alignment with company priorities.

  • RFP Strategy & Partnership — Collaborate with Programs and Business Development teams to anticipate RFP cycles and align CAI’s solutions with state priorities, emphasizing innovative, and research‑based assessment models.

  • Stakeholder Engagement — Build trusted relationships with state and district leaders and partner organizations to support implementation, alignment, and long‑term success of assessment programs.

  • Internal Collaboration — Work across internal teams to align offerings with state and district needs, support innovative solutions, and ensure coordinated engagement and successful delivery. This role partners closely with CAI’s Leadership Team.

Strategic Alignment & External Engagement

  • Solution Positioning & Education — Engage state education stakeholders to build understanding of CAI’s solutions, demonstrating value, outcomes, and alignment with system priorities.

  • Coalition Building & Thought Leadership — Represent CAI at high‑profile meetings, conferences, and public forums to position the organization as a thought leader in educational assessment and innovation.

Job Requirements:

  • Industry Expertise — Minimum 10+ years of experience in educational business development, government relations, or state education agencies, including at least 5 years focused on K–12 student assessment or EdTech. Experience in state government relations and direct advocacy is highly preferred.

  • Proven Track Record — Demonstrated success influencing and supporting state‑level education procurement for large‑scale programs.

  • Technical Literacy — Ability to communicate fluently about psychometrics, computer‑adaptive testing (CAT), item development, program management, and ethical considerations of AI in education.

  • Professional Network — Established relationships across state education agencies, assessment leaders, and national education organizations are highly preferred.

  • Education — Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree or JD highly preferred.

  • Travel — Ability to travel 25–50% to support priority state engagements and industry conferences.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a dynamic and experienced Oracle Security Architect to join our organization. This pivotal role will report directly to the Sr. Director, Threat Intelligence and Client Security Services. Qualified candidates can work remotely, preferred location is Mexico City, other locations in Mexico may be considered.

Position Summary

The Oracle Security Architect will support the Rimini Protect! Security Services team to research threats, vulnerabilities, and weaknesses that affect the products and services supported and delivered by Rimini Street. The Oracle Security Architect will work with Rimini Protect team to research the applicability of reported Vulnerabilities to understand the weaknesses and exposures, determine applicable mitigations, and assist in the documentation of those mitigations.

The Oracle Security Architect will also write document and recommend work arounds and mitigations to assist in the development of new solutions and security controls that will be utilized by Rimini Street clients to proactively address vulnerabilities from a 0-day context as well as our regularly schedule Security Vulnerability Analysis Report (SVAR) In addition to those activities, they will be closely work with the Client Success Managers (CSM) to conduct, review and make recommendations in the process of conducting a Security Audit for the customer’s ERP solution and Database environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Extensive research of security vulnerabilities and their underlying weaknesses.
  • Provide support to Product Support Engineer (PSE) for cases opened by the customers that are dealing with Security Vulnerabilities.
  • Bring clarity to diverse datasets of information, providing reporting for executive ingestion and decision making.
  • Review, suggest, and implement improvements for security practices.
  • Evaluate complex business and technical requirements and then communicate inherent security risks and solutions to technical and non-technical business owners.
  • Assist in the design, implementation, and evaluation of security-focused tools and services (understand tools and capabilities).
  • Development of logic (including rules and signatures) as well as hardening configurations to mitigate the risk of vulnerabilities.
  • Stay current on emerging security threats, vulnerabilities and controls.
  • Evangelize security and be an advocate for customer trust.
  • Provide leadership and innovation in the design and implementation of security solutions and controls.
  • Provide critical feedback to security solution providers and guidance in the development of product enhancements and features.
  • Other job-related duties and responsibilities may be assigned from time to time.
  • Conduct Security Assessments for Customers and Prospects, covering variety of ERP environments

Education & Certification

  • At a minimum bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.
  • Security Certification Required or actively working on the certification

Experience

  • 5-8+ years of progressive information security responsibility and experience.
  • Exposure to common industry and regulatory standards - ISO, NIST, SOX, PCI, Privacy Shield.
  • Highly technical and hands-on is a must.
  • Skilled in risk management, business risk analysis and making complex business/risk trade-off recommendations and decisions.
  • Strong knowledge in current security threats, trends and mitigations.
  • Experience in design and delivery of enterprise-level security controls.
  • Experience in performing audits and reviews of ERP systems
  • Detailed knowledge of system security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques and mitigation techniques.
  • Experience with Apache is a plus

Qualifications & Skills

  • Ethical with highest standards of integrity.
  • Ability to think critically and make clear, responsible and well-reasoned decisions.
  • Passionate focus on customer support and the ability to build long term, successful working relationships with Clients.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written.
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing and speaking English
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly.
  • Extreme focus on Client satisfaction.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure, high stress situations.
  • Well-developed presentation and communication skills; effective working with clients.
  • Threat hunting and mitigation.
  • Ability to develop relationships based on trust, confidence and respect with customers and colleagues.
  • Ability to multi-task multiple issues and tasks.
  • Ability to scale with a rapidly growing business including addition of products and countries.
  • Oracle Database Experience along with Apache &/or WebLogic
  • Willingness to work off hours for short periods when required (i.e. Working a ZeroDay event)

Desired Skills

  • Open-Source security solutions (any of the following): Burpe Suite, Kali Linux, Metasploit, Horizon3.ai, Feedly, Firewall Experience, WAF Experience, AI tools like Copilot
  • Securing (Hardening): Java JRE and JVM’s; Apache, experience in patching a plus; WebLogic; WebSphere;
  • Database Experience: Oracle, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DB2
  • Application Experience a plus in any of the following: EBS, OBIEE, BI Publisher; JD Edwards; Siebel; Hyperion

Location

Remote - Mexico City

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients
    • We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,300+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 23 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

Job Description:

Director, Medical Expense Management
